notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 69-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.6, creatinine 1.09, hemoglobin 12.9, platelets 296, sodium 139, wbc 7.6; vitals dbp 67-70, heart_rate 68-72, map 88-90, o2_flow 0-2, resp_rate 18-21, sbp 130-132, spo2 92-96, temp 36.9-37.2
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Oxygen 2 L/min nasal cannula for comfort
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. Not in respiratory failure.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 1.08, hemoglobin 13, platelets 290, sodium 139, wbc 7.6; vitals dbp 66-72, heart_rate 70-74, map 88-92, o2_flow 0-2, resp_rate 16-18, sbp 127-134, spo2 94-96, temp 37-37.1
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. Not in respiratory failure. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 69-year-old female, length of stay 2 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. Not in respiratory failure. Follow up with primary care in one week. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed.
